notes: Closing the window with a render going now really does ask first — and so does ⌘Q, which the last build still skipped. Plain-English refusals are honoured too: “don’t make it vertical, just compress it” compresses and leaves the shape alone, where it used to reframe the whole clip and drop the compress. “Boost the gain by 3×” changes the volume instead of starting a long upscale. And when Crisp can’t write next to your clip — a locked SD card, a mounted disk image — it saves to your Movies folder instead of failing.
